title: uscopylint JSON findings
description: Each item is one edit to the scanned snapshot. A clean scan returns an empty array.

column.description: First Unicode code point of this edit, counted from 1.

endColumn.description: Exclusive end column, counted in Unicode code points.

word.description: Original text in this source span.

suggestion.description: Replacement for this span. An empty string deletes it.

sourceLine.description: Original decoded line without its line terminator.

phrase.description: Rendered phrase spanning JSX fragments. Use its starting location to group the edits.
